My best prediction is that it would flag the case urgently to the manager, but—unless written permission is registered before the date changes—leave the expiry unchanged and include the box in the manifest released by 13:30. On these facts, the box would then be collected and destroyed that day.

The booked Wednesday collection and the pending extension request do not take it off the manifest or authorize an extension. The loss is irreversible, but the policy and the manager’s instruction give the assistant no authority to make an exception on its own.
